decisions.reason: After the 2024 assortment cleanup, this carpet remains a good fit for the firm's interior concepts and the reduced overlap in the rug range lowers, but does not remove, rationalization risk.
This low-pile carpet still complements the firm's accessories and project business well, though carpets remain a category where the firm may simplify the collection again if it reallocates resources.

The swivel shell chair line aligns strongly with the firm's residential, workplace and public-interior positioning and with its focus on flexible contemporary environments, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
